notes.title: 🙌 HANDS UPdate 0.5.0 🙌
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28159242/1ceaf06d767f57e7cf79b77a0e8c1669b4785036.png[/img]

This is definitely a HANDS ON update!
The most wished for feature ever has come: HANDS
Yes, that’s right! Our research team worked day and night to discover this new technology, called hands. That, and to actually put them in the game.

[b]ALL PLATFORMS[/b]
I borrowed a Oculus Rift S from my “Publisher” and was finally able to make SSL:O work on the Oculus platform. This and the new hands should also work on the Valve Index (which I currently do not have but will). So we have the 3 major platforms for you available to play on 🎉

[b]Less heavy, more metal![/b]
The shield lever decreases WAY more slowly, so you do not have to hold it anymore and it will stay “online” until it decreases below 42%.
Space Pirates will now fly around before shooting, giving you precious time to enter the weapons code and/or bringing up the shields. There is also a warning on screen to help you notice when they are there (they were pretty easy to miss during the action).
Longer timeouts for the buttons were really needed in the heat of action and re-configuring the waves to make it easier to get into the game—no worries veterans, it still gets harder ;)

[b]But wait! There is more![/b]
A new simple loading scene should make micro stutters less likely, tons of performance improvements and small bug fixes were also added to make for a much smoother experience. Hunting down all those performance gremlins is not an easy task and far from done, but there are already noticeable improvements.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28159242/2684284f594ba8406e9f51ba1f27819beb1d1caa.gif[/img]

Hope you have as much fun with this update as I had making it ːghsmileː

-- bison

notes.title: Update 0.4.2 TOTALLY NOT THE ANSWER
notes.notes:
Hello fellow engineers,

I rebalanced the difficulty; it was just too hard to even reach the 10th level.
So it was surely frustrating for some of you to not get very far and I hope I’ve fixed that Issue now.
There are also a lot of tweaks here and there and overall game quality improvements.
As always, the most important changes as a handy list:

[list]
[*]Updated to Unity 2017.3 (that was a hell of an Update!)
[*]Space Pirates are now slower and way harder to miss
[*]the shield does not block your weapon fire anymore
[*]additional perimeter alert for incoming Asteroids
[*]slider won’t be assigned the value they currently have (which had resulted in “instant-solving”)
[*]debounce Buttons: sometimes buttons could be pressed multiple times by accident, this should be fixed now
[*]not so “Bloody Halloween Update”
[*]some lighting performance improvements
[/list]

I messed up the Halloween Update and never published it, because I couldn’t fix the performance Issues of the Blood. Finally here it is: [spoiler]Tribbles can now be killed by the Ventilators[/spoiler], but without the blood, so it’s a bit of a compromise.

notes.title: Update v0.4.0 - Trouble with the Tribbles 🖖
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28159242/7a062d2c1d31ef9957c72ed112afc3242d271e1c.png[/img]
Every ticket in Alpha 4 is finally closed, so here comes Version 0.4.0 🎉

After way too long of a period of silence (damn you heat wave!), here comes a pretty big Update. I must say that this is one I’ve wanted to do since I started with the Prototype back in 2016, but priorities are important in gamedev ;).
So better late than never, enjoy your fluffy fellows <3

[list]
[*]Tribbles
[*]replicator
[*]food
[*]re-recorded voice overs <3
[*]new voice overs
[*]steam cloud saves ☁
[*]general sound improvements
[*]sliders now have indicator lamps (that can break)
[*]new breakdown effects
[*]new crowbar sounds
[*]better smoke
[*]hypercube
[*]neat boxes
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b] 

[list]
[*]fixed some missing colliders
[*]fixed infinite flying weapon-fire (could improve performance in late game)
[*]fixed an error with the throwable crate
[*]some objects were falling over on second start
[*]fixed rare case when reflections were not updated properly
[*]space pirates don’t shoot themselves anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.3.1 - Mr. Freeman
notes.notes:
Big things need time (aka. Rome wasn’t built in a day), so this update brings a big and really needed feature: FREE MOVEMENT.
BE FREE MAN!
The space Loma needed was always a bit odd, because the console tables had to be directly in front of the player and in the middle of the play area, which resulted in the problem that some players couldn’t reach all controls because they didn’t have enough space to the left while to the right plenty of space wast just wasted.
Now you can bring yourself into a position where reaching all controls is possible.
[list]
[*] Free movement with teleportation
[*] Table size handles overhauled (watching all those youtube videos gave me an idea how you, the players, expect those things should work, and I hope I nailed it ;)
[*] Head blocker (it blocks your head)
[*] Fixed some objects that just fell over when the game starts (not always) 
[*] Improving some 3D models for the new free movement era
[*] A handful of minor bug fixes that probably only a developer will notice
[/list]
Not as many points as I wished there would be, but getting the free movement to work was a pretty big point.

notes.title: Update v0.2.4 - it’s dangerous to go alone ...
notes.notes:
… take this tutorial!
It is awesome to see so many people enjoying the game already ❤️❤️❤️
Thanks for playing it and your feedback.
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLxh-UkRJhsTDh1p5y-OPy-uF1NByITCra
But as much as I love to see you being confused and panicking while trying to figure out what to do, the need for a proper (or at least some sort of a) tutorial was very obvious.
So this update gets one. But IF you are the sort of person who likes to figure out stuff by themselves, you do not have to use it ;)
[list]
 [*]Tutorial (totally optional)
 [*]Game main menu–yes, in VR it is a BIG thing ;)
 [*]Level selection: You can now select the level you want to start at (as long as you’ve made it that far first)
 [*]Buttons tweaked: There is still work to do, but the buttons should feel smoother now
[/list]
https://youtu.be/wc1Dgl1KnmA

notes.title: Update v0.2.3 - shields up
notes.notes:
I am very proud to announce the first update. Got some awesome feedback from friends and customers, but also the first bug reports, and I tried to fix all issues you probably had as well.
So there is not much new content, but the loma sector is now a "safer" place.
[list]
    [*]Button fade color: the button fading is now way more visible
    [*]Asteroid: the asteroid warning should be more visible now. I also fixed the asteroid speed so you have way more time to react
    [*]Shield lever: in some VR setups player couldn’t reach the shield lever, the play area was moved a bit to the left and the lever closer to the player
    [*]UI: re-arranged the interface and it should be less confusing (I feel like I will have to do that a lot of times before the final game release)
    [*]Level 3: many people had issues with level 3, it has now been re-balanced
    [*]Size handles: the table size handles should be more useful now
    [*]Font update: all pixelated fonts should be gone now
    [*]Level loading: improved
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yUjW9Irj-GA
